focusQuestions: 现有论文如何衡量幻觉或回答忠实性？
检索到的材料何时能改善回答，何时反而引入错误？
不同方法的结果有什么共同点和分歧？

segments.text: The study measures answer faithfulness by checking whether each claim is supported by retrieved passages.
The retrieved documents sometimes contain conflicting statements, and the model may repeat an unsupported claim.
